status: source-only proposal; the canonical QCD n3 case is closed, but no private diagnostic driver has been built or raw worker qualified
request_schedule: fixed backend order 1, 6, 7, 8, 9; each attempted at most once

points.source: complete previously frozen cut-qualified physical input stream; byte-for-byte reuse across all five workers

sampling.colors: summed with the unchanged generated normalization
sampling.renormalization_scale: MU_R equals the incoming invariant mass; 1000 GeV for the saved stream

policy.precision: host forced-DP diagnostics using the exact sealed source5 worker
policy.backend_observation: effective singleton card selection; unchecked return code 110 does not identify the internal reducer or its precision
policy.MLReductionLib: exactly the selected backend followed by the zero sentinel
policy.numerator_model_and_reducers: reuse the newly closed canonical export and its qualified numerical objects; change only the private diagnostic driver and explicit numerical cards
policy.classification: the sealed current-source classifier may remove only the incoming-latch reason for an authenticated generated worker whose two outgoing software latches are clear; all group, nonfinite, coverage, status, warning, bootstrap, split-order and completeness gates remain
policy.stdout_and_stderr: retain the complete merged console and every failure; no diagnostic suppression

admission.closed_input_binding: closed-input.json is a separate source payload, authenticated by the reviewed source seal; it pins the exact owner checkpoint, generation/compilation receipts and canonical export identity
admission.closure_gate: authenticate the sealed closed-input.json and exact checkpoint SHA256, and require status closed before opening any export path
admission.owner_checkpoint: the benchmark owner has now closed the QCD n3 checkpoint and root has permitted read-only admission; a successful build alone would not permit reading an active export
required_joins: exact current campaign manifest, complete exporter and numerical source inventories
generation case and campaign binding, full numerical rebuild receipt, compiled source hashes and executable identity
actual generated loop matrix, qualified public-entry reset and wrapper, process prefix, dimensions and initialized coefficient layout
exact rendered source5 worker, private build receipt, private executable and admitted runtime mappings
private tree and finite external link closure, preserved canonical donor tree and production sources
full physical-card search and all resources, current physical card and mass probe matching the complete frozen point stream
admission.execution_gate: root still reviews the exact source seal and closed-case binding before compiler, loader or amplitude execution; current read-only permission grants no compiler or native execution

preparation.dryrun: make five separate private worker copies, exercise card writes/readback, physical-card lookup and read-only guards; launch no child
preparation.native_search_environment: clean compiler and launcher environment; apply the exact admitted LD_LIBRARY_PATH only at target execve

cli.scope: commands are a proposed interface; this protocol records no command execution or source admission

statistics.observable: finite coefficient divided by Born; raw Born, finite and Laurent coefficients are retained
statistics.metric: relative spread of the three forced-DP observables, using the unchanged sealed metric implementation
statistics.population: 100 fixed points per backend, including rejected and unexecuted points
statistics.unavailable: retain reasons and fixed-population lower/upper tail bounds; never replace a failed point
statistics.interpretation: internal consistency diagnostic, without independent true-error, hardware IEEE exception, runtime acceptance or observed internal precision claims

delivery.new_evidence: a separate additive source-bound dataset and any later explicitly reviewed figures
delivery.canonical_report_promotion: separate root review; not authorized by this source-only proposal
